main_text.l: do prophetis & hæreticis pessundatur. Pro pe-culiari ergo ordinis & status sui ratione, pios sub-ditos in verâ religione & cultu tuendo, blasphe-mos verò coërcendo, gloriam Dei asserere tene-tur. Quemadmodum David populum suum hoc pacto in simplicitate cordis sui pavit,& pru-dentiâ manuum suarum eos deduxit, Psal.78. verf.72: vicissim verò omnia cornua impiorum fregit, ut contra Deum se efferre non possent,ut exaltarentur cornua justi, ita nimirum, ut erecto capite Deum colere, & tranquillè in regno ver-sari queant, Psal.75. v.10.11; singulis item matu-tinis omnes impios terræ succidit, ut extermina-ret de civitate Jehovæ omnes operarios iniqui-tatis, Psal.101.v.8. Sic enim reges nutricii eccle-siæ, & reginæ nutrices esse debent, & proni in terram incurvare se ecclesiæ, Esa.49. verf.23. Sive ergo gloriæ Dei asfertionem, sive societatis hu-manæ conservationem respicere velit magistra-tus, in nullum hominum genus severius, quàm in blasphemos, hæreticos & idololatras animad-vertere tenetur. Quod tamen dum facit, non hic illi scopus proprie propositus est, ut vel ani-mas regat; vel immutet, vel ad veram fidem & cultum cogat; id quod fidei & conversionis na-tura minus fert: sed ut externam, tam in religio-ne, quàm in civili conversatione τάξιαν[?], deco-rum, concordiam & tranquillitatem conservet. Cùm enim varia sint hominum ingenia, mul-tosque, quos Dei timor, & virtutis amor non movet, poenæ formidine coërceri sit necesse; u-trumq; magistratus præstat, gladiū hîc stringens.

page.notes: The running head "CAPUT III." is printed at the top centre; it is a division number, so it is given here as the head level 1 entry rather than in running_head. The Greek word after "conversatione" is printed in small type and its reading is doubtful: transcribed as τάξιαν[?]. The word "extermina-" is set in the scan with a letter that may be a Cyrillic-like a; written as Latin a. Printing spelling left as printed (e.g. "possent,ut", "verf.", "Psal.75. v.10.11;"). Old-style long s replaced by plain s throughout. Some faint marks and a diagonal stroke at the right edge are show-through or stains, not transcribed.
